items.title: AMD, NVIDIA raise bar on AI energy efficiency

items.summary: SINCE the pandemic, sustainable development reports have been getting thicker, more colorful and broader in scope.

items.summary: The first week of the the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) COP17 is just wrapping up its first week.

items.title: UK Government urged to funnel £1bn into heat networks
items.summary: Government efforts to invest £1bn in heat networks today could unlock £4bn in wider investment opportunities, all while pushing the nation towards its net-zero ambitions by accounting for one-fifth of heating demand.

items.title: 2026全球減碳浪潮下的台灣淨零現況
items.summary: 隨著全球氣候變遷加劇，各類極端氣候災害帶來的經濟與社會成本持續攀升。聯合國政府間氣候變化專門委員會（IPCC）在其核心報告中明確指出，人類活動產生的溫室氣體已造成全球平均升溫超過攝氏1度，氣候風險已不再是未來的預測，而是企業當前必須面對的實質成本。

items.title: Shanghai Electric Fuels Record 8,000-Ton Bunkering

items.title: Europe’s AI Data Centres Shift Beyond Major Cities

items.title: New Zealand Curbs Climate Litigation Against Major Emitters
items.summary: The Climate Change Response Amendment Bill passed its third reading on August 18 by 67 votes to 53. It amends the Climate Change Response Act 2002 and applies to current and future proceedings.
